# Gallery full screen

*[Deutsch](galerie.de.md)* · [All templates](../TEMPLATES.md)

<p align="center"><img src="../vorlagen/galerie-de.webp" width="100%" alt="Gallery full screen"></p>

<p align="center"><sub>Recorded from the real TV stream</sub></p>

**For:** picture frame, photo wall, menu as PDF

## What you see

One gallery folder across the whole screen, picture by picture (PDFs page by page too).

**Background:** plain colour `#000000`. Colour scheme *dunkel*, accent `#3d8cd0`, font Roboto.

## Elements used

| Element | Shows |
|---|---|
| Gallery (pictures/PDFs) | gallery folder, every 15 s |

## Make it yours

New layout from the template: **Content → Layouts → + New layout → Start from**.

- Pick the folder in the editor; pictures come from a NAS, the cloud or are uploaded.

*Without live video: about half the computing power of a template with video.*
